name: Curse IV
description:
Bursts an enemy for 375% damage and inflicts OMINOUS CURSE on them. If there's no summon on the field, summon one.

OMINOUS CURSE: When the unit dies, a Bone Nightmare spawns and fights for the summoner's team. It suffers a 14% max HP decay per turn, is three times as likely to be chosen as target and has a 35% counterattack chance.
